text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Kitasan Black...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Paka Petit!
How nostalgic~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking in the direction Kitasan Black is pointing, there is a crane game filled with plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan is super good
at crane games!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Before I enrolled, I used to stop by all the time on my way home from watching races!
Naturally, hoping to catch a glimpse of Teio-san and the others!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they've added more varieties since then~
I'm pretty clumsy, so I doubt I could win one, though... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black seems curious about the Paka Petit.
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
Are you sure it's okay~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
